dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted, time-discounted distribution of terminal equity outcomes (rNPV). The common is a deep out-of-the-money call option on a 5G turnaround clearing ~$50-65M of senior obligations; each scenario = (forward EV at a sector-appropriate 2.5-4.5x EV/Sales - net obligations) / an explicitly-bridged, dilution-adjusted terminal share count (130-165M), weighted and discounted at a 16% cost of equity (rf 4.3% + 1.6xERP 5.0% + 2% size + 1.7% illiquidity/distress).
dossier.thesis_summary: GCTS is a near-insolvent fabless 5G/4G modem company (FY2025 revenue $2.9M - only $1.1M of it chip product - negative gross margin, $43M net loss, $31M cash burn, negative $74-83M tangible equity, going concern). The business does not reach EBITDA breakeven until ~$55-68M revenue - about 20x current and >2x its best year ever - so the common is economically a deep out-of-the-money option on a dilution-funded turnaround, subordinated to $57.7M of debt ($35.4M related-party). Probability-weighting a ~42% restructuring/wipeout, ~32% sub-scale survival, and ~26% reaches-scale-or-better distribution (anchored to the poor base rate for independent modem houses) gives a fair value of $0.22 (band $0.15-$0.40) over a ~$0 liquidation floor.
key_value_drivers: Probability of clearing the ~$60M EBITDA-breakeven revenue wall before insolvency/excessive dilution
Terminal share count (130-165M+) driven by how much equity the bridge consumes; death-spiral converts add shares as price falls
Success-case EV/Sales multiple (2.5-4.5x; product-company margin caps it near Lantronix/Sequans tier)
Monetization of NTN/satellite-D2D optionality (named volume program) and the MaxLinear FWA channel
Continuous access to dilutive capital (ATM + converts) at a non-trivial price
key_risks: Liquidity/solvency: ~$15M cash vs ~$25M/yr burn; survival depends on dilutive ATM + death-spiral converts
Dilution convexity from variable-price converts compounds weakness
Related-party lenders (Anapass, Chairman Lee, $35.4M) control restructuring; common is subordinated
Customer concentration (4 = 74% of revenue), no firm long-term purchase commitments
Competes vs Qualcomm/MediaTek/UNISOC/ASR; peak-ever revenue only $25.5M (2021); poor base rate for independent modem houses
FWA CPE ASP compression erodes revenue-per-unit even if units ramp
what_would_change_my_mind: A named, volume satellite-D2D UE production program (e.g., confirmed Globalstar order)
MaxLinear-enabled FWA design wins converting to large ODM ramps
A quarter with product (not service) revenue scaling toward $10M+/qtr at positive product gross margin
A non-dilutive financing, strategic investment, or IP/company sale removing the death-spiral dependency
Conversely: a halted ATM, covenant breach, or down-round restructuring -> wipeout tail
